title: Schedule of Service Charges — Reconnect Fees, Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
Reconnect fee figures of Electric Service by Rate Schedule, by schedule, together with whether a reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection requires a security deposit record on the service account:

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reconnect fee, meter reconnected remotely | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 |
| Reconnect fee, crew truck during business hours | $75.00 | $75.00 | $75.00 | $75.00 | $110.00 | $110.00 | $185.00 |
| Reconnect fee, crew truck outside business hours | $150.00 | $150.00 | $150.00 | $150.00 | $210.00 | $210.00 | $325.00 |
| Security deposit record required for reconnection after nonpayment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Reading the schedule

- The remote figure is $25.00 on all seven schedules.
- The business-hours truck figure is $75.00 on Schedules R, RS, FH and GS-1, $110.00 on Schedules GS-3 and IR, and $185.00 on Schedule LP.
- The after-hours truck figure is $150.00 on Schedules R, RS, FH and GS-1, $210.00 on Schedules GS-3 and IR, and $325.00 on Schedule LP.
- Every schedule requires a security deposit record for a reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection.

### Quick comparison (figures from the table)

| Schedule | Business-hours truck figure less the remote figure |
|---|---|
| Schedule R | $50.00 |
| Schedule GS-3 | $85.00 |
| Schedule LP | $160.00 |
